# Mint

> Mint is an Indian business news platform covering markets, companies, economy, personal finance, technology, and policy.

Mint publishes breaking business news, live market coverage, analysis, opinion, and explainers for India and global audiences. It also offers topic hubs for stock markets, mutual funds, insurance, tax, cryptocurrencies, and consumer technology.

## Core News
- [Home](https://www.livemint.com/): Main news homepage with top business, market, economy, and policy stories.
- [Latest News](https://www.livemint.com/latest-news): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest stories across all coverage areas.
- [Politics](https://www.livemint.com/politics): Indian political news with policy, elections, and government decision coverage.
- [News](https://www.livemint.com/news): General news hub spanning India, world, business, and current affairs.
- [Opinion](https://www.livemint.com/opinion): Columns, editorials, and expert commentary on business, economy, and policy.
- [Lounge](https://www.livemint.com/mint-lounge): Mint Lounge features on culture, lifestyle, ideas, and long-form storytelling.

## Markets
- [Markets](https://www.livemint.com/market): Main markets hub for equities, indices, commodities, and trading news.
- [Stock Market News](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news): Daily stock market coverage, trading updates, and company-specific moves.
- [Mark To Market](https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market): Market analysis and commentary on listed companies and sectors.
- [IPO](https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo): IPO news, subscription updates, allotment details, and listing coverage.
- [Commodities](https://www.livemint.com/market/commodities): Commodity market news covering metals, energy, and agricultural trends.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://www.livemint.com/market/cryptocurrency): Crypto prices, regulation updates, and digital asset market coverage.
- [Stock Markets Today](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news): Live-oriented stock market reporting for Indian equities and indices.

## Economy & Industry
- [Economy](https://www.livemint.com/economy): Coverage of macroeconomics, inflation, growth, jobs, and fiscal policy.
- [Industry](https://www.livemint.com/industry): Sector news across manufacturing, telecom, retail, energy, and infrastructure.
- [Companies](https://www.livemint.com/companies): Corporate news, earnings, leadership changes, deals, and strategy updates.
- [Technology](https://www.livemint.com/technology): Technology business news, platforms, startups, AI, and digital policy.
- [Consumer](https://www.livemint.com/consumer): Consumer sector reporting on brands, retail, demand, and spending trends.
- [Politics](https://www.livemint.com/politics): Policy-linked political developments affecting business and the economy.

## Money & Personal Finance
- [Money](https://www.livemint.com/money): Personal finance hub covering savings, investing, borrowing, and financial planning.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.livemint.com/money/personal-finance): Advice and reporting on budgeting, loans, retirement, and wealth management.
- [Mutual Fund](https://www.livemint.com/mutual-fund): Mutual fund news, SIP strategies, fund performance, and regulation updates.
- [Insurance](https://www.livemint.com/insurance): Insurance news and explainers on health, life, and general coverage.
- [Tax](https://www.livemint.com/money/personal-finance/tax): Tax planning, filing guidance, and policy changes affecting individuals.
- [Banking](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking): Banking sector coverage including lenders, regulation, and deposit trends.

## Technology & Gadgets
- [Technology News](https://www.livemint.com/technology): News and analysis on tech companies, platforms, and digital regulation.
- [Tech Reviews](https://www.livemint.com/technology/tech-reviews): Reviews of smartphones, laptops, wearables, and consumer gadgets.
- [Mobiles](https://www.livemint.com/technology/mobiles): Smartphone launches, pricing, features, and mobile ecosystem coverage.
- [Apps](https://www.livemint.com/technology/apps): App launches, updates, platform changes, and usage trends.
- [AI](https://www.livemint.com/technology): Technology coverage often including AI products, policy, and adoption stories.
- [Web Stories](https://www.livemint.com/web-stories): Visual short-format stories on news, markets, and technology topics.

## Markets Data & Prices
- [Gold Price](https://www.livemint.com/gold-prices): Gold rates in India with city-wise pricing and daily updates.
- [Silver Price](https://www.livemint.com/silver-prices): Silver rates in India with updated prices and local market context.
- [Petrol Price](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices-petrol): Petrol prices across Indian cities with daily rate tracking.
- [Diesel Price](https://www.livemint.com/fuel-prices-diesel): Diesel prices across Indian cities with daily updates.
- [Market Stats](https://www.livemint.com/market/market-stats): Market statistics pages for stocks, indices, and company-level data.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://www.livemint.com/market/cryptocurrency): Crypto market coverage with price-focused reporting and explainers.

## Multimedia & Special Formats
- [Videos](https://www.livemint.com/videos): Video news, interviews, explainers, and market updates.
- [Podcasts](https://www.livemint.com/podcast): Audio shows and podcast episodes on business, markets, and policy.
- [Web Stories](https://www.livemint.com/web-stories): Swipeable visual stories summarizing trending topics and explainers.
- [Photos](https://www.livemint.com/photos): Photo galleries accompanying major news, events, and feature coverage.
- [Infographics](https://www.livemint.com/infographics): Data-led visual explainers on markets, economy, and public policy.

## Premium & Newsletters
- [Mint Premium](https://www.livemint.com/mint-top-newsletter): Entry point to premium-style curated editorial products and newsletters.
- [Newsletters](https://www.livemint.com/newsletters): Newsletter hub for curated updates across business and markets.
- [Opinion](https://www.livemint.com/opinion): Subscriber-relevant commentary and analysis from editors and guest writers.
- [Long Story](https://www.livemint.com/long-story): In-depth reported features and analytical long-form journalism.
- [WSJ at Mint](https://www.livemint.com/wsj): Wall Street Journal content and international business reporting carried by Mint.

## Utility & Site Information
- [E-Paper](https://www.livemint.com/epaper): Digital newspaper edition for replica-style reading of Mint.
- [Topic Index](https://www.livemint.com/topic): Topic pages aggregating coverage by company, person, or subject.
- [Author Pages](https://www.livemint.com/author): Directory of Mint authors and their published articles.
- [About Mint](https://www.livemint.com/about-us): Information about the publication, editorial mission, and company background.
- [Contact Us](https://www.livemint.com/contact-us): Contact information for editorial, support, and business inquiries.
- [Subscribe](https://www.livemint.com/subscription): Subscription options for accessing Mint products and premium offerings.
